AFdoc is a bottom-up national PhD funding scheme of the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR); proposals from all fields are eligible and projects are carried out at any host institution worldwide (public PhD-awarding institutions abroad or Luxembourg-based R&D companies), so no supervising professor is attached to the scheme itself. The page lists FNR coordination staff (Asaél Rouby, Angelina Clemens), not academic supervisors. Live-verified at https://www.fnr.lu/funding-instruments/afdoc

Flanders Trainee Programme is a Government of Flanders internship grant for placements with multilateral organisations (e.g. UN, UNESCO), administered by the Department of Foreign Affairs (contact: stages.dkbuza@vlaanderen.be). It has no university/academic supervisor component, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable. Live-verified at https://www.vlaanderen.be/en/studying/flanders-trainee-programme

Estonian Scholarship Programme is a government (Ministry of Education and Research / Education and Youth Board) stipend scheme paid via any Estonian host university, open across all disciplines with no named supervisors attached to the scheme. Programme contact is Liis Uulman, Scholarships and Grants Office (administrative officer, not a supervisor). Live-verified at https://www.harno.ee/en/scholarships-and-grants/scholarships-studying-and-working-estonia/scholarships-international

UC Doctoral Scholarship (UCDS) is a centrally funded University of Canterbury award open to a research doctoral degree in any discipline at UC; the official scholarship pages (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/scholarships/doctoral-scholarships/uc-doctoral-scholarships) name no professors or supervisors, listing only application rounds, values ($32,650 per 120 points + tuition fees up to 360 points) and eligibility rules. Because the scholarship is discipline-agnostic, no verified supervising professor exists to attach; applicants nominate supervisors later with their department. Live-verified on canterbury.ac.nz.

VCIHAS is a coursework tuition-fee reduction (50% of tuition for undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degrees) at Charles Darwin University, awarded on academic-merit criteria with no research supervision or named faculty involved, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable. Live-verified at https://www.cdu.edu.au/international/how-apply/scholarships
